description: Search Stockfilm's archive of authentic vintage home movie clips from the 1930s-1980s. Returns clips with metadata, pricing, thumbnails, and licensing info. All footage is real 8mm/Super 8 film — no AI-generated content.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default 10)

query.description: Natural language search query. Be descriptive: '1960s california family barbecue' works better than just 'family'.

name: search_vintage_footage
